title: Series and parallel resistor branches (electric currents, analytic)
description:
Two resistor branches between terminal blocks at V0 (left) and 0 V (right), separated by an insulating strip (no sigma_dc).
Series branch: material 1 over L1 then material 2 over L2, I_series = w_s V0/(L1/sigma_1 + L2/sigma_2). Parallel branch: strips of width w_1 (material 1) and w_2 (material 2) over the full length L1 + L2, I_parallel = V0 (sigma_1 w_1 + sigma_2 w_2)/(L1 + L2).
Derived values tab: I_series, I_parallel, I_series_out (= -I_series) and P_joule (= V0 (I_series + I_parallel)), exact to ~1e-6 (the finite-volume scheme is exact for piecewise-linear V).
Line profile tab: V_series (kink at the material interface), V_parallel (straight), J_cross_section (J_x across both branches: two levels in the parallel strips, 0 in the gap, one level in the series branch).
Field tab: V, J_x, q_joule.

parameters.name: V0
parameters.description: voltage of the left terminals [V] (right terminals at 0 V)

parameters.name: w_1
parameters.description: parallel branch: width of the material 1 strip

parameters.name: w_2
parameters.description: parallel branch: width of the material 2 strip

parameters.name: gap
parameters.description: insulating strip (no sigma_dc) between the branches

parameters.name: L_t
parameters.description: terminal block length at each end

parameters.name: dx_cell
parameters.description: uniform cell size (every edge on a cell edge)

parameters.name: y_s
parameters.description: lower edge of the series branch

analytic_curves.name: V_series
analytic_curves.expression: where(x < L_t, V0, where(x < L_t + L1, V0 - V0/(L1/sigma_1 + L2/sigma_2)*(x - L_t)/sigma_1, where(x < Lx - L_t, V0/(L1/sigma_1 + L2/sigma_2)*(Lx - L_t - x)/sigma_2, 0)))

analytic_curves.name: V_parallel
analytic_curves.expression: where(x < L_t, V0, where(x < Lx - L_t, V0*(Lx - L_t - x)/(L1 + L2), 0))

analytic_curves.name: J_cross_section
analytic_curves.expression: where(y < w_1, sigma_1*V0/(L1 + L2), where(y < w_1 + w_2, sigma_2*V0/(L1 + L2), where(y < y_s, 0, V0/(L1/sigma_1 + L2/sigma_2))))
